items.text: V Easy APK must reach the approved VisionD APIs from its packaged WebView and distinguish offline CORS and HTTP failures
items.acceptance: restricted CORS and OPTIONS contracts pass and the mobile runtime reports actionable connection states

items.text: The owner can cancel only unpaid unshipped orders with one stock release and can edit save or safely remove products
items.acceptance: cancel is atomic idempotent and audited; products hard-delete only without order history and otherwise become hidden

items.text: The owner can start and stop the server bot and switch between ready LINE and Facebook chat views without stopping it
items.acceptance: readiness gates each channel, LINE is green, Messenger is blue, switching preserves server running state, and stop revokes runtime control

items.text: Mobile activity alerts must queue without overlap, pin unresolved urgent actions, and paginate overflow into pages 2 3 4 and beyond
items.acceptance: the notification center persists FIFO and deduplicated actions, reserves urgent space, shows total and page x of y, and pulls later work forward after resolution

items.text: Uncovered chat COD approval and other owner-required cases use sound reminders while unresolved, with normal actions using remaining space
items.acceptance: urgent actions remain until explicitly resolved or snoozed, repeat at the selected 5 10 or 30 minute interval, and never create an audio storm

items.text: B1 delivers only VisionD Web ZIP and signed V Easy APK to Boss; matching V Easy Source stays private and versioned inside the team
items.acceptance: the two Boss artifacts exist and match while private source builds the APK reproducibly and is never replaced by decompiling an old APK

items.text: The complete B1 flow must be smoke-tested on the approved Redmi device without claiming unsupported native background behavior
items.acceptance: record install activation connection cancel product CRUD bot chat switch action pagination reminders Back QR and session behavior; note that Nitron in-app polling stops if Android kills the process
